build: CUDA 13.0.0, SM120, vision disabled, locally compiled before runtime

hardware.memory_scope_note: Original upstream RAM field detects OS-usable memory. Installed capacity independently confirmed from four 16 GB DIMMs.

runtime: Dedicated unprivileged Debian 13 LXC on Debian 13.7/Proxmox 9.2.20; kernel 7.0.14-17-pve; Docker 26.1.5; NVIDIA Toolkit 1.20.1-1
cache_state: Warmed resident process; upstream warmup discarded. Model preparation warmed filesystem cache. No storage-cold claim. Fresh official prompts have unique tags; follow-up prompt reuse is measured separately.
measurement: Unmodified ./bench.sh and tools/strata_bench.py; three repetitions, thinking off; upstream engine throughput and client streaming TTFT semantics retained.
runtime_network: Docker network none; benchmark client shares isolated loopback namespace; no external/LAN access or host-port publication.
background_load: Existing LXC workloads stopped; one-second host/LXC/container telemetry active. No model downloads, packing or vulnerability scanning during timed official runs.

settings.route_tail_skip: upstream default 7; missed-expert skipping affects approximation and is retained for both quants
settings.metric_note: Requested spec=4; engine_info exposes mtp_max and a separate aggregate spec/lookup field. Do not interpret all speculation as MTP alone.

limitations: Speed suite does not measure answer quality. Separate Sonny Labs scoring and needle tests are supplied separately.
Optional two-client test uses one serial service slot; --batch is off. Combined throughput includes queueing, not concurrent GPU batching.
Upstream --url mode does not write engine-log-excerpt.txt; original logs are retained in experiment evidence.
submission_note: Original README.md/results.json preserved byte-for-byte; supplement status/public report metadata updated for authorized submission.
